title: music-model-ci-gate: CI adapter for check_decision_v5
purpose: Integration contract and thin adapter shell that slots check_decision_v5.py (art_01M6SQH2ECQZH73P9EP9XHKB47 r1) into a pre-release CI gate. Separates the five licence-check interfaces from the CI pipeline interface so each can change independently. Demonstrates mechanism: the checker is a pure function (JSON-in, errors-out, deterministic exit code); the adapter is the boundary between that function and whatever triggers a release workflow.
